text:
riley (People Ops): Hi @margo — Ben's 04/01 pay had much higher federal withholding than expected after his salary increase. Can payroll confirm whether the new salary was double-counted or a supplemental tax code applied?

margo (Payroll): Can you paste a redacted stub or last4 and pay period so I can pull the record?

riley (People Ops): redacted snippet from Ben's DM:
```
Pay period: 04/01/2026 - 04/15/2026
Base pay: $4,500.00
Salary adj (retro import): $3,000.00
Gross: $7,500.00
Federal tax: $2,250.00 (30%)
Net: $4,000.00
```
Employee: Ben Castillo, EmpID 48233, last4 1122

ben (Engineer): I submitted promotion effective 04/01 in Workday; people ops approved 03/24. Expected payroll to use new rate for current period only, not retro.

sam (Eng Manager): Ben confirmed no bonus or one-time payout.

margo (Payroll): @payroll-bot pull payrun for EmpID 48233 period 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-15 and show earnings lines + tax codes.

payroll-bot: Retrieving payrun... Found record. Payroll import shows two earnings rows: 1) Base pay at new salary, 2) Retro salary adjustment imported as a separate earning with tax code `SUPP`. System treated the adjustment as a supplemental/one-time earning and applied supplemental federal withholding flow in addition to regular withholding on base pay. Creating ticket PAY-6123 for manual review and correction.

riley (People Ops): If this is a duplicate import, will an off-cycle reversal remove the supplemental withholding? Ben needs cashflow this week.

margo (Payroll): For a processing/import error we can run an off-cycle to remove the duplicate earning and recompute taxes. That will reduce federal withholding and update YTD. No employee consent required. ETA: 1-3 business days after triage; marking priority. We'll note W-2 effects in the ticket.

ben (Engineer): Thanks — appreciate the priority. I'll DM a screenshot of the Workday approval for 03/24 to help audits.

margo (Payroll): please DM it and I'll attach to PAY-6123. Also checking benefits: pre-tax deductions were tied to earning codes `REG` and were applied only to the base pay row, so removing the supplemental won't change pre-tax benefit amounts, just the taxable gross used for federal/state.

sam (Eng Manager): Good to know. Can we add a reminder for HRIS/payroll cutoff sync so promotions after cutoff don't create retro imports?

riley (People Ops): I'll add a note to the payroll cutoffs doc and ping HRIS.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from sam, :eyes: from margo)
